title: PvP Enhanced+
description: This pack has many PvP and utilities
body:
PvP Enhanced+ textures pack has many features for you to improve your PvP skills 
Here are some pack's features:
- Low fire, shield 
- Visible ore, powdered snow
- Dark mode 
- Brewing guild 
- Clean 3D crystals, water
- Small totem pop
- Restone tweaks
- Brighter nether
- Invisible item frame, fishing hook

All credits in the pack's files

Download CurseForge version here: [PvP Enhanced+ CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/pvp-enhanced)
